name: special-offer
blurb: Full-width sale banner with animated countdown timer and promo code display.
description: Full-page-width cyber sale banner with gradient background, animated countdown timer (days/hours/minutes/seconds via useEffect RAF), promotional text, promo code box, and responsive layout.
use_when: You need a prominent, time-limited sale announcement with visual countdown and strong branding.
avoid_when: For simple promotions; this is visually intensive and focuses on urgency.
a11y: Text is readable. Countdown updates every second. Animation-heavy design may not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
